prefix.canonical_identity: OP.java OreDictPrefix field declaration plus the serialized identity passed to create/unused

declared_transformations.description: A dump source_name equal to an OP serialized identity remains that canonical prefix.
A name declared by addIdenticalNames belongs to that OP canonical prefix.
An OP field assigned directly to another OP field is a source variant of the target serialized identity.
If an addIdenticalNames member is also its own OP canonical serialized identity, the direct canonical declaration owns the dump row.
A normalized dump member not declared as an OP identity, identical-name alias, or field variant is retained in the exclusion ledger.
Mappings declared by tools/gt6_prefix_mapping.json connect OP identities to current CrucibleCraft prefixes.
blockGem and blockIngot intentionally map to the one CrucibleCraft block form.
pipeMedium/pipeLarge/pipeHuge each project to distinct fluid and item runtime forms.
The eight selected T8 fluid/item pipe forms map to pipeTiny/Small/Medium/Large/Huge.
T10 adds double, triple, and hot ingot runtime forms.

created_unmapped.reason: The pinned OP prefix has no current CrucibleCraft runtime mapping; T13 records the denominator without designing a new form.
created_unmapped.replacement_condition: A later milestone selects the canonical prefix and supplies source-backed generation, serialization, and acquisition semantics.

unused_unmapped.reason: The pinned OP declaration is explicitly PREFIX_UNUSED compatibility vocabulary.

dump_only.reason: Runtime dump identity is not a canonical declaration or declared alias/variant in pinned OP.java.

itemgenerator_domains.canonical_identity: ITEMGENERATOR.* TagData identity declared in TD.ItemGenerator and present in the fixed GT6 tag-domain report

declared_transformations.description: TagData.createTagData serialized identities are canonical source identities.
GASSES is a source field alias of GASES and never creates a second domain.
The denominator contains the 25 TD identities observed by the fixed GT6 material dump; eight source-declared but unobserved identities remain in an exclusion ledger.
The frozen second-stage boundary identifies exactly 16 current CrucibleCraft domains.

ITEMGENERATOR.ARMORS.reason: Material-derived armor generation is a G10 peripheral domain outside T14-T19.

ITEMGENERATOR.CONTAINERS.reason: Generic containers are broader than the current fluid/gas cell routes.
ITEMGENERATOR.CONTAINERS.replacement_condition: A source-backed generic container identity and acquisition model is selected.

ITEMGENERATOR.EMPTY.reason: EMPTY is a source sentinel/material shortcut, not a standalone CrucibleCraft generated form.

ITEMGENERATOR.GASES.reason: Gas is represented by fluid state and container eligibility rather than a generated material item domain.

ITEMGENERATOR.LENSES.reason: Lens forms are not in the current 56-prefix runtime set.
ITEMGENERATOR.LENSES.replacement_condition: A selected T16-T19 machine batch requires source-backed lens generation and acquisition.
ITEMGENERATOR.LENSES.recheck_point: Recheck at each T16-T19 batch selection.

ITEMGENERATOR.LIQUID.reason: LIQUID is a material state tag and is not a standalone item-prefix publication domain.

ITEMGENERATOR.PLANTS.reason: Plant drops are a G10 peripheral domain outside T14-T19.

ITEMGENERATOR.PROJECTILES.reason: Projectile and ammunition forms are a G10 peripheral domain outside T14-T19.

ITEMGENERATOR.RAILS.reason: Rail forms have no current runtime prefix or selected third-stage consumer.
ITEMGENERATOR.RAILS.replacement_condition: A post-T19 transport scope selects rail generation and acquisition.
